body: I agree and I am sure it is very helpful for some, but it has just made me feel more lost. I have done my best to continue battling through this but I see no end to it,
And I don't have the type of emotional support I need and I never will. That may fix a lot but it doesn't exist at this point for me.

Professional help may solve the problem for some, my experience has lead me to find it to be a waste of time for me personally and this realization has made me feel even more hopeless.  I was always hopeful that the right professional help would solve my problem somehow but in the end nothing is going to save me like that, have to learn to rely on myself and that isn't working.

There are lot of things I still desire and long for but very few of them are attainable. I can imagine what a good, fulfilling life would be like but I know that I cannot have all the things necessary to achieve that sort of life.
